<!-- Why: Project tooling and setup so study time goes to Flutter code. -->

You write tests. You never modify `lib/` (a hook denies it). Every test file
you create starts with the `AI-GENERATED` header and is added to the register
in `docs/AI_CONTRIBUTIONS.md` (format there); every block you add to an
existing test file gets BEGIN/END markers. When a test reveals
a bug in `lib/`, you report the failing assertion and the suspected line; the
user fixes it.

## Where tests go

- `test/<same path as lib>/<file>_test.dart`. `lib/mahjong/models/tile.dart` →
  `test/mahjong/models/tile_test.dart`.
- Fakes in `test/fakes/fake_<interface>.dart`, class `Fake<Interface>` (e.g.
  `FakeLessonRepository implements LessonRepository`). Hand-written, no mocking
  library. Keep them deterministic and tiny; expose knobs as constructor params.
- Goldens under `test/<path>/goldens/`.

## Recipes (verified against flutter_riverpod 3.4.3 — read
`~/.pub-cache/hosted/pub.dev/flutter_riverpod-3.4.3/lib/` if unsure)

Unit test of a provider:

```dart
final container = ProviderContainer.test(
  overrides: [lessonRepositoryProvider.overrideWithValue(FakeLessonRepository())],
  retry: (_, _) => null, // Riverpod 3 auto-retries failing providers; disable in tests
);
final units = await container.read(unitsProvider.future);
```

Widget test of a screen:

```dart
await tester.pumpWidget(
  ProviderScope(
    overrides: [...],
    retry: (_, _) => null,
    child: const MaterialApp(home: LessonScreen(lessonId: 'u1-l1')),
  ),
);
```

- `MaterialApp` comes from `package:material_ui/material_ui.dart`, never
  `package:flutter/material.dart`.
- `tester.container()` reaches the live container inside a pumped `ProviderScope`.
- Override a `Notifier`'s `build` without subclassing:
  `currentLessonProvider.overrideWithBuild((ref, notifier) => ...)`.
- Screens that use go_router need a real `GoRouter` in the test; build a minimal
  one with just the route under test and pump `MaterialApp.router`.

Golden test for the one tile renderer:

```dart
await expectLater(find.byType(TileWidget), matchesGoldenFile('goldens/tile_5p_red_selected.png'));
```

One golden per `TileState` × a representative tile; update with
`flutter test --update-goldens` only when the user confirms the change is intended.

## Style

- `group` per class/function, `test`/`testWidgets` names read as sentences.
- Arrange / act / assert with blank lines between; no comments that restate code.
- Tests follow the same lint rules as `lib/` (`flutter analyze` covers `test/`).
- Prefer one behaviour per test; no loops over cases unless a table makes it clearer.

## Finish

Run `flutter test <files you wrote>` and report the real output. If red because
of `lib/`, say which assertion failed and what you believe is wrong, then stop.
